title: Tune Muon matrix LR (MATRIX_LR sweep)
description: Changed MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 (Muon LR for transformer matrix params), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005825, worse than baseline 1.002279 (~0.35% regression). The current MATRIX_LR=0.04 appears close to a local optimum for this model/batch size; increasing it by 25% hurts rather than helps. A follow-up decreasing MATRIX_LR (e.g. to 0.03) could still be worth one run to check if the baseline is at the peak of the curve or if lower LR is better, but this direction (higher LR) is now ruled out.
